dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. For the correspondence, is your usual secure channel still convenient? I can also record your preference for a concise covering message without changing the formal documents.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will note that preference. The formal correspondence will remain separate from the brief covering message. You can contact me if you need help locating a document.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Good, less chasing around for paperwork lor. My assistant handles the business diary, but personal bank messages I check myself. Otherwise everything gets mixed up and very troublesome.
